reported.title: Heartbeat stalls during blocking chime pulse
reported.description: pulseChimeBlocking() calls delay(CHIME_MS) at line 27, which blocks the loop for 1800 ms, so the heartbeat check at lines 57-62 cannot run during the pulse. Measured evidence shows gaps of 2000 ms and 1900 ms between 'gate-hb' lines, far outside the 300 ± 100 ms requirement. Expected /^gate-hb$/ every 300 ± 100 ms; 5 of 8 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2000 ms.

reported.title: Firmware silent for 1800 ms during chime
reported.description: The blocking delay(CHIME_MS) at line 27 halts all serial output and pin activity for the full 1800 ms pulse, exceeding the 700 ms silence limit. Measured evidence reports 'no activity for 1800 ms' repeatedly across scenarios. Firmware went silent for 1800 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^gate-hb$' every 300 ms (Gate heartbeat)
responds to stimulus within None ms (Stay responsive)

judge_input.spec:
- Porch gate contact on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW when open); chime driver on D10.
- A settled open event as short as 40 ms starts an 1800 ms HIGH pulse on D10 within 150 ms.
- Presses while the chime is already sounding are ignored (pulse length is not restarted).
- Print the exact line `gate-hb` every 300 ms continuously, including while the chime is sounding.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
- Closed/idle gate reads HIGH on D3.
